spans.s:
Pumāṃs denotes in the Rigveda and later man as the ‘male.’ It has no special reference to marriage like pati, or to heroism like Nṛ or nara. In grammar it denotes the masculine gender.
Foot notes i. 124, 7; 162, 22; iii. 29, 13; iv. 3, 10, etc.
Av. iii. 6, 1; 23, 3; iv. 4, 4; vi. 11, 2; Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā, viii. 5, etc.
nirukta, iii. 8; Śatapatha brāhmaṇa, x. 1, 1, 8; 5, 1, 3; Cf. iv. 5, 2, 10, and puṃṣā nakṣatreṇa, ‘a nakṣatra with a masculine name,’ in the Bṛhadāraṇyaka upaniṣad, vi. 3, 1.
